identityReviewRetry.observedSource:
Isvan is a 39-year-old man whose defining facial-hair pattern is a large broad golden-brown chin beard with a moustache-free upper lip. Upper-lip skin is fully exposed apart from isolated tiny dark stubble dots, widely scattered with visible pale skin between them. Dense beard hair starts beside and below the mouth. Two tall thick side columns rise beside the mouth corners to lower-lip height. Two narrow pale vertical gaps below the lip separate these columns from the central beard. The front beard is roughly twice the closed mouth's width, very full across the front chin and deep below it, ending in a broad gently tapered spade shape. The lateral cheeks and jaw outside this front beard are bare.

His fair warm beige skin has pink nose and cheeks, fine pores and ordinary uneven texture. A long broad oval has high full cheeks, a firm jaw and rounded chin under the beard. Cool grey-blue almond eyes have dark rims and pupils, mild hooding and straight dark eyebrows. His brow is relaxed and level, with a calm forehead between the eyebrows. A long straight prominent nose has a broad rounded tip and medium wings. Closed muted beige-peach lips are thinner above and fuller below. Preserve restrained adult eye lines, natural asymmetry and ordinary thirty-nine-year-old maturity. No identifiable personal scar or tattoo is visible.

Sandy ash-brown hair is a fully haired medium loose mane, swept backward from a central pointed V and passing the ears to the neck. Personally inspected Khoroman has paler skin and longer lighter hair; retain Isvan's warmer broad oval and cool eyes.
